Method of Attack: Deploying web shells on vulnerable Microsoft Exchange servers
Exploiting ProxyLogon vulnerabilities to gain access
Post-exploitation activities including ransom note creation
Use of Python script compiled as Windows executable
Impacted Systems: Microsoft Exchange servers vulnerable to ProxyLogon attacks
Exchange servers in US, Russia, Canada, Germany, Austria, Switzerland, France, Israel, United Kingdom, Italy, Greece, Australia, Croatia
Attack Vector: ProxyLogon exploits on Microsoft Exchange servers
Pulse Secure VPN exploits (for previous Black Kingdom ransomware in 2020)
Indicators of Compromise: Web shells observed on approximately 1,500 Exchange servers
ID Ransomware submissions from impacted mail servers starting March 18
Ransom notes warning of data theft and public release if ransom not paid
